name.en-US: The Mystical Explanation of the Canticle of Canticles
name.pt-BR: A Explicação Mística do Cântico dos Cânticos

description.en-US: Francis de Sales's six discourses on the Canticle of Canticles as a treatise on mental prayer: the hindrances to prayer, their remedies and the five degrees of the soul's ascent, in Canon Mackey's English version.
description.pt-BR: Os seis discursos de São Francisco de Sales sobre o Cântico dos Cânticos como tratado de oração mental: os obstáculos, os remédios e os cinco graus de ascensão da alma, na versão inglesa do cônego Mackey.

en-US.editor: H. B. Mackey, O.S.B., foreword by the Archbishop of Westminster (London: Burns & Oates, 1908)

sources.edition: The Mystical Explanation of the Canticle of Canticles, tr. H. B. Mackey, Library of St. Francis de Sales VI (London: Burns & Oates, 1908), Internet Archive full-text OCR. Chantal's Depositions, printed in the same volume, are left out.
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Francis de Sales died in 1622 and the edition is of 1908, so the text is public domain.
